textos.Dirigido por Ari Aster e lançado em 2018: Directed by Ari Aster and released in 2018, Hereditary is a production that combines elements of horror, mystery and thriller. The narrative begins with the death of the reclusive matriarch of the Graham family, from which point the relatives begin to uncover disturbing secrets. As a dark presence and a growing terror settle into the house, especially around the solitary young Charlie, the family seeks to escape the unfortunate fate they have inherited.
textos.A experiência ao assistir ao filme é con: The experience of watching the film is driven by a deliberately slow, measured pace. This cadence is tied to the creation of an atmosphere charged with tension and continuous apprehension.
